responsibility: Implements derivation of scope-local quad ranges from the global gm2 quadruple stream. It scans procedure and module boundaries, tracks nesting of `ProcedureScopeOp`, `ModuleScopeOp`, returns, and finalization markers, builds linked `ScopeBlock` records describing contiguous ranges per outer scope, and wraps iteration with `M2Error` scope entry/leave calls so downstream optimization, analysis, and code-generation passes operate with both correct quad subsets and matching diagnostic context.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation module for the M2Scope pair: it contains the actual quad-stream traversal, nested procedure/module scope tracking, `ScopeBlock` record layout, and `M2Error.EnterErrorScope`/`LeaveErrorScope` handling. Unlike `M2Scope.def`, it realizes how contiguous quad ranges are discovered and iterated.
